---
title: "TAOOH first-order Markov model — diagnostics"
subtitle: "Convergence and graphical checks of the first-order models"
format: html
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(here)
library(arrow)
library(yaml)
library(rms)
library(rmsb)
library(mostr)
library(posterior)
library(tidyverse)

config <- read_yaml(here("config", "analysis.yml"))
source(here("R", "markov.R"))
source(here("R", "taooh.R"))
source(here("R", "plot-style.R"))

indices <- seq_len(config$imputation$m_supporting)

horizon_days <- config$analysis$horizon_days
stopifnot(horizon_days %% 7 == 0)
horizon_weeks <- as.integer(horizon_days / 7)

results_dir <- here("analysis", "04-taooh", "04-first-order-markov", "results")
model_dir <- here(results_dir, "models")
stan_dx_dir <- here(results_dir, "stan-dx")
figure_dir <- here(results_dir, "figures")
dir.create(stan_dx_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(figure_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Same thresholds as in fitting: up to 19 divergent transitions are accepted.
taooh_diagnostic_thresholds <- config$diagnostics
taooh_diagnostic_thresholds$max_divergent_transitions <- 19L
```

## Convergence summaries

```{r}
#| label: convergence-summaries
#| include: false

diagnostics_table <- indices |>
  map(\(index) {
    model <- readRDS(here(model_dir, sprintf("model-%02d.rds", index)))
    diagnostics <- markov_diagnostics(model, taooh_diagnostic_thresholds)
    assert_markov_diagnostics(diagnostics)

    as.data.frame(diagnostics$summary) |>
      mutate(
        imputation = index,
        divergent_transitions = diagnostics$divergent_transitions,
        treedepth_exceeded = diagnostics$treedepth_exceeded,
        min_bfmi = diagnostics$min_bfmi
      )
  }) |>
  list_rbind()

write_parquet(
  diagnostics_table,
  here(results_dir, "diagnostics.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)
```

```{r}
#| label: stan-diagnostics
#| include: false

for (index in indices) {
  model <- readRDS(here(model_dir, sprintf("model-%02d.rds", index)))

  writeLines(
    capture.output(stanDx(model)),
    here(stan_dx_dir, sprintf("stan-dx-%02d.txt", index))
  )

  # All coefficients and the random-intercept SD (sigmag).
  trace_parameters <- c(colnames(model$draws), colnames(model$omega))
  save_figure(
    plot_traces(trace_draws(model, trace_parameters), ncol = 4),
    here(stan_dx_dir, sprintf("stan-dx-%02d.png", index)),
    height = 1.3 * ceiling(length(trace_parameters) / 4) + 1
  )
}
```

## Graphical checks

```{r}
#| label: empirical-data
#| include: false

cohort <- read_parquet(
  here("analysis", "00-data", "results", "analysis-cohort.parquet")
) |>
  as.data.frame()

empirical_data <- read_parquet(
  here("analysis", "00-data", "results", "analysis-taooh.parquet")
) |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  taooh_carry_death_forward(horizon_days) |>
  left_join(cohort |> select(id, tx), by = "id") |>
  arrange(id, week) |>
  group_by(id) |>
  mutate(
    y = as.integer(y_taooh),
    yprev = lag(y)
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(between(week, 1L, horizon_weeks)) |>
  mutate(
    y = factor(y, levels = 1:5, ordered = TRUE),
    yprev = factor(yprev, levels = 1:5),
    tx = group_factor(tx)
  )

model <- readRDS(here(model_dir, "model-01.rds"))

diagnostic_times <- c(1L, 3L, 6L, 9L, 12L, 16L, 20L, 24L, 26L)
diagnostic_seed <- config$seeds$diagnostics + 2000L
```

```{r}
#| label: graphical-checks
#| include: false

# mostr adds theme_bw() to its diagnostic plots: use the report theme and keep
# the heatmap settings.
heatmap_theme <- theme(
  panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
  axis.ticks = element_blank(),
  aspect.ratio = 1
)
transition_style <- list(
  labs(x = "Previous state", y = "Current state"),
  theme_liqplat(),
  heatmap_theme
)
correlation_style <- list(
  labs(
    x = "Week after random selection",
    y = "Week after random selection",
    fill = "Correlation"
  ),
  theme_liqplat(),
  heatmap_theme
)
variogram_style <- list(
  labs(x = "Time difference, weeks", y = "Correlation"),
  theme_liqplat()
)

# White value labels on the transition heatmaps.
empirical_transition_plot <- plot_transitions(
  empirical_data,
  times = diagnostic_times,
  time_var = "week",
  y_var = "y",
  p_var = "yprev",
  y_levels = 1:5,
  show_values = TRUE
) +
  transition_style
if (length(empirical_transition_plot$layers) >= 2L) {
  empirical_transition_plot$layers[[2L]]$aes_params$colour <- "white"
}

model_transition_plot <- plot_transitions(
  model,
  times = diagnostic_times,
  y_levels = 1:5,
  absorb = 5L,
  time_var = "week",
  p_var = "yprev",
  id_var = "id",
  seed = diagnostic_seed,
  n_draws = 200L,
  show_values = TRUE
) +
  transition_style
if (length(model_transition_plot$layers) >= 2L) {
  model_transition_plot$layers[[2L]]$aes_params$colour <- "white"
}

empirical_correlation_plot <- plot_correlation(
  empirical_data,
  times = seq_len(horizon_weeks),
  y_levels = 1:5,
  id_var = "id",
  time_var = "week",
  y_var = "y",
  show_values = TRUE
) +
  correlation_style

model_correlation_plot <- plot_correlation(
  model,
  times = seq_len(horizon_weeks),
  y_levels = 1:5,
  absorb = 5L,
  id_var = "id",
  time_var = "week",
  p_var = "yprev",
  seed = diagnostic_seed,
  n_draws = 50L,
  show_values = TRUE
) +
  correlation_style

empirical_variogram_plot <- plot_variogram(
  empirical_data,
  times = seq_len(horizon_weeks),
  y_levels = 1:5,
  id_var = "id",
  time_var = "week",
  y_var = "y"
) +
  variogram_style

model_variogram_plot <- plot_variogram(
  model,
  times = seq_len(horizon_weeks),
  y_levels = 1:5,
  absorb = 5L,
  id_var = "id",
  time_var = "week",
  p_var = "yprev",
  seed = diagnostic_seed,
  n_draws = 50L
) +
  variogram_style

diagnostic_plots <- list(
  "empirical-transitions.png" = empirical_transition_plot,
  "model-transitions.png" = model_transition_plot,
  "empirical-correlation.png" = empirical_correlation_plot,
  "model-correlation.png" = model_correlation_plot,
  "empirical-variogram.png" = empirical_variogram_plot,
  "model-variogram.png" = model_variogram_plot
)

iwalk(diagnostic_plots, \(plot, filename) {
  save_figure(
    plot,
    here(figure_dir, filename),
    height = case_when(
      str_detect(filename, "transition") ~ 9,
      str_detect(filename, "correlation") ~ 8,
      .default = 5.5
    )
  )
})
```

- Correlation shown: dense weekly data make it estimable
